add.title: Give /framework/ai/ the same head as its subpages (AI title + tab row) and retire the dashboard's pill row
add.why: The subpages (queue, log, tasks) show the AI title with the sticky tab row (Inbox, Dashboard, Log, Queue, ...); /framework/ai/ shows a big h1 and a separate pill row with a different set of links (Ready to merge, Sessions, Now, ...). Two navigations for one section (law 6). Kept the pills, moved back to the top, in the 2026-10-24 dashboard landing; unify the link sets first.
